strategy_roster.name: Candle Trend
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and roc(close,1) > 0 and roc(close,2) > 0
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < open and roc(close,1) < 0 and roc(close,2) < 0
strategy_roster.notes: The documented rule is a run of same-direction candles, so a bullish body plus one- and two-bar rising closes approximates the run; the mirrored bear run is the documented opposite-signal exit. TrendCandles has no documented value so three bars is the fallback, and the optional percentage take profit and stop loss have no supplied numbers.

strategy_roster.name: SuperTrend AI Oscillator
strategy_roster.notes: The SuperTrend line is built from the documented AtrLength=10 with Factor=1, so a cross above the band-offset line is the trend flip, and RSI(14) above 50 stands in for the custom oscillator. The trailing stop and RiskReward=2 exit are ATR-relative rather than fixed percentages, so both fields stay null.

strategy_roster.name: Averaging By Signal
strategy_roster.notes: The documented fast/slow lengths FastPeriod=28 and SlowPeriod=50 give the crossover entry, with the opposite cross as the exit since the basket target is a pip aggregate. Martingale averaging layers, LayerDistancePips, MaxLayers, Multiplier sizing and the first-order-only trailing stop are not representable in a single-position DSL.

strategy_roster.name: ColorMaRsi Trigger
strategy_roster.notes: The combined EMA-minus-RSI difference reproduces the -1/0/+1 signal, so a cross above zero is the documented sign flip that opens the long. No periods are documented so EMA 10/50 and RSI 5/20 are fallbacks, and the short side plus BuyMarket/SellMarket routing are not long-roster fields.

strategy_roster.name: XCCI Histogram Vol
strategy_roster.notes: CCI times volume smoothed by a moving average is approximated by the standardized price deviation times volume_ratio and then SMA, with the high zone and midline as the zone thresholds. CciPeriod, MaLength and the four level multipliers have no documented values so 20/20 and 1/0 are fallbacks, and SignalBarOffset and point-based stops are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Jpalonso Modoki
strategy_roster.entry_long: close <= sma(close,200) * 0.9965 or (close > sma(close,200) and close <= sma(close,200) * 1.0035)
strategy_roster.notes: The envelope uses the documented SmaPeriod=200 and Deviation=0.35%, and the long rule keeps both the lower-envelope touch and the documented upper-half band case. TakeProfit=127 and StopLoss=77 are point distances rather than percentages, so both fields are null.

strategy_roster.name: FlexiMA x FlexiST
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > sma(close,20) and close > donchian_high(high,2) - atr(high,low,close,10)
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < sma(close,20) or close < donchian_high(high,2) - atr(high,low,close,10)
strategy_roster.notes: Price must sit above the simple moving average and above the SuperTrend band line, which is built here from a two-bar extreme offset by one ATR. The SMA length and SuperTrend factor are undocumented fallbacks (20 and ATR 10 with factor 1), and the docs state no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Extreme EA (StockSharp Conversion)
strategy_roster.entry_long: roc(ema((high + low + close) / 3,15),1) > 0 and roc(ema((high + low + close) / 3,75),1) > 0 and crossbelow(zscore(close,12), -2)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented FastMaPeriod=15 and SlowMaPeriod=75 exponential averages on the median price supply the two rising-slope conditions, and the CCI filter is approximated by a 12-bar z-score with the CciLowerLevel=-50 mapped to -2. MaximumRisk sizing, DecreaseFactor loss reduction, MaxPositions and the multi-timeframe CCI subscription are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: TF Segmented Linear Regression
strategy_roster.notes: A two-deviation linear channel around the mean is the closest available proxy for the regression channel, so the documented upper-band crossing enters and the opposite band crossing exits. The Segment time window is not expressible on a single series, and the docs state no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Build Your Grid
strategy_roster.notes: The document describes a two-sided order ladder with pip steps, geometric or exponential lot progression, a basket profit target and hedge orders sized from the volume difference, so there is no single-symbol market-derived entry signal to translate. The never-true guard is used instead of inventing one, and no percentage stops are documented.
